test_title: PYST 13: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.**

If you think atheists are all miserable, __nihilistic__ amoralists, this book should put you straight.
solution: The correct answer is **"cynical."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word** 'nihilistic' **means rejecting all religious and moral principles, often in the belief that life is meaningless. (इस विश्वास के साथ कि जीवन निरर्थक है, सभी धार्मिक और नैतिक सिद्धांतों को अस्वीकार कर दिया।) • **Example:** *The film was heavily criticized at the time for its bleak and **nihilistic**__ content.* • The word **'cynical'** means believing that people are motivated purely by self-interest; distrustful of human sincerity or integrity. (हरेक को स्‍वार्थी समझने वाला) __ • **Example: ***That was a **cynical**__ remark.* • The most appropriate synonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence is **"cynical."** • So, the correct answer is **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let us explore other options: • **Conical** means having the shape of a cone. (शंकु के आकार का, शंक्‍वाकार) • **Tyrannical** means exercising power in a cruel or arbitrary way. (अत्‍याचारी, ज़ालिम) • **Canonical** means according to or ordered by canon law. (कैनन कानून के अनुसार या दिया गया आदेश) 3b:T547,Here, the erroneous part is **"She never did apologized."**
